name: Soldier
description: Steady Aim applies Focused for one phase, setting up an accurate attack.

name: Defender
description: Brace applies Guarded for two phases, trading mobility for staying power.

name: Scout
description: Surge refunds three action points and applies Quickened for one phase.

name: Medic
description: Field Dressing restores four vitality to an injured ally within four tiles.

name: Engineer
description: Shock Drone deals three direct damage to a hostile within four tiles.

name: Psionic
description: Neural Disrupt hinders a hostile's accuracy for one phase at range five.

name: Biotech Specialist
description: Spore Ward grants the entire active squad regeneration for two phases.

name: Vanguard
description: Hold the Line guards every ally within two tiles for two phases.

name: Pathfinder
description: Ghost Vector refunds two action points, then applies Quickened and Focused.

name: Lifewright
description: Vital Cascade heals three vitality and grants two phases of regeneration at range five.

name: Null Adept
description: Null Lance deals two direct damage and disrupts a hostile for two phases at range six.
